text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"We've finally made it... The legendary 
ramen shop...!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To become the number one ramen shop in 
Japan, I'm gonna steal this flavor for 
myself!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, we're gonna eat every single type at 
lightning speed! Keep up with me, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Just one recommended dish is plenty!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey now, don't go chickening out on me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait... What if focusing exclusively 
on a single, supreme dish actually has the 
opposite effect...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This is ramen crafted with 
an artisan's passion! There's no need to 
eat bowl after bowl!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Boss! Tell me what you recommend 
here!

Gold Ship fully enjoyed the secret golden 
broth and firm thin noodles, truly 
mastering the essence of the Way of Ramen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Time to take 'em all on, one 
by one!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I got a hint...! I see the light 
at the end of the tunnel...!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's climb to the very top together! 
Along this long and rugged path of ramen!

Behind Gold Ship, the red setting sun 
shone with a brilliant sparkle.
